newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico first-half CPI rose 0.49 percent - cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Mexico first-half CPI rose 0.49 percent - cenbank.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index rose 0.49 percent in the first half of June from the last two weeks of May, Banco de Mexico said.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 0.60 percent in the first two weeks of June from the last half of May.
A Reuter survey of analysts' forecasts MEX22 showed an average expectation for first-half June inflation of 0.47 percent.

Banco de Mexico said the main causes of inflation were an increase in prices of housing, domestic fuel, local telephone services, autofuel, electricity, rail fares, and soft drinks and other products.
